name: protendai/nativephp-mobile-ocr
description: Free, on-device OCR (text recognition) and document scanning for NativePHP Mobile v4 on iOS and Android. ML Kit on Android, Apple Vision on iOS. Works offline.

bridge_functions.name: Ocr.Recognize
bridge_functions.description: Recognise text in an image file. Async: the result arrives as TextRecognized or RecognitionFailed.

bridge_functions.name: Ocr.Capture
bridge_functions.description: Take a photo with the back camera via the phone's camera app, then recognise it. Async: TextRecognized, RecognitionFailed or ScanCancelled.

bridge_functions.name: Ocr.Scan
bridge_functions.description: Open the platform document scanner (back camera, edge detection, crop), then recognise the page. Async: TextRecognized, RecognitionFailed or ScanCancelled.

info_plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to photograph documents and read the text on them.
